Do khoảng cách giữa Vũng Tàu – Bắc Ninh.en: Due to the gap between the Chinese – North Ning is quite far away, the option of rail transport is safe, consistent. Because goods could be transported with mass, Mohammad Mead, especially cost cheap. Furthermore, the train sailed on the fixed track that suffered less traffic collisions, so the time of rapid, precise travel was limited.
Do khoảng cách giữa Vũng Tàu – Bắc Ninh.zh: 由于中国人之间的隔阂——北宁相当遥远,铁路运输的选择是安全的,一贯的. 因为货物可以随质量运输,穆罕默德·米德,特别是成本低廉. 此外,列车出行于交通相撞次数较少的固定轨道上,因此快速,精确出行的时间有限.

Theo chỉ dẫn của Google Maps, nếu chạy q.en: According to Google Maps' instructions, if you run through Route 1A, the distance from the Train to the NH is approximately 1.97 km (697 km) long, which is approximately 32 hours long. So the time for shipping from the China Gang to go to North Europe took about 4 to 6 days.
Theo chỉ dẫn của Google Maps, nếu chạy q.zh: 根据Google Maps的指示,如果运行于1A路,从列车到NH的距离约为1.97公里(697公里)长,约32小时长. 所以从"中国帮"到北欧的航运时间大约需要4到6天.
